title: checkout-api 5xx rate 18% (threshold 2%)
details: Started 4 minutes after Argo rollout of checkout-api v2.41.0 reached 50%. p99 latency 4.2s. Top log line (x 3,812): 'sqlalchemy.exc.OperationalError: (psycopg2.OperationalError) server closed the connection unexpectedly' and 'pgbouncer: no more connections allowed (max_client_conn)'. v2.41.0 changelog: 'add analytics engine for order events'.

title: Kafka consumer lag on otp-events > 200k
details: Lag 212k and rising. OTP SMS p95 delivery 6 minutes. Logs: 'consumer poll timeout has expired. This means the time between subsequent calls to poll() was longer than the configured max.poll.interval.ms'. HPA is proposing a scale from 8 to 20 replicas.
